asserts.value: not a white hair on its body

asserts.pick: a different horse running in Silver Blaze's place

reasoning.text: Ross scratched his other horse, so the only horse in his colours is Silver Blaze. A bay with no white hair fits the disguise Brown offered to 'change' and Holmes told him to leave.

set.given_quote: how he had led it back and concealed it at Mapleton

reasoning.text: Holmes told Brown not to 'change it'. The horse now runs with no white hair, so Holmes let him run still disguised.

The murderer is 'in my company' in the owners' enclosure, where only Watson, the Colonel and the horse are with Holmes. The horse was in the hollow at the struggle, and no man led it away, so a kick from the horse fits.
The silent dog points to Straker himself taking the horse out at night. With the lame sheep, the cataract knife and the light in the hollow, he was working against the horse in his charge.
